text.en:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Imigresen (Larangan Masuk)

(Pindaan) 2026.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 3 Jun 2026.

Pindaan Jadual

2. Perintah Imigresen (Larangan Masuk), 1963 [L.N. 227/1963] dipinda dalam

Jadual, berhubung dengan perenggan D, dengan menggantikan subperenggan (ii)

dengan subperenggan yang berikut:

"(ii) having been married on or after the 1st day of December 1954,

has not at any time been living separately from her husband—

(A) for a continuous period of three years for Peninsular Malaysia and

the Federal Territory of Labuan; or

(B) for a continuous period of five years for Sabah and Sarawak.".

Dibuat 3 Jun 2026

[KDN.IM.S.600-1/3/6JLD.7(11); PN(PU2)100/JLD.19]

DATO' ZAKARIA BIN SHAABAN

Ketua Pengarah Imigresen Malaysia

IMMIGRATION ACT 1959/63

IMMIGRATION (PROHIBITION OF ENTRY) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 9 of the Immigration Act 1959/63

[Act 155], the Director General, with the concurrence of the Chief Ministers of Sabah

and Sarawak, makes the following order:
